standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of extension by zero and its compatibility with tensor products
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Lemma lemma-extension-by-zero-exact (tag 09BG) and Lemma lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor (tag 09BH)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two tools that let exactness be transported to and from the site.

core_obligations: Let G_1 -> G_2 -> G_3 be an exact complex of modules on U; use exactness of j_{U!} and flatness of F over O to conclude that the complex of extended-and-tensored modules is exact (proof lines 4588-4595).
Use the compatibility j_{U!}(G_i tensor_{O_U} F|_U) = j_{U!}G_i tensor_O F to identify that complex with the extended tensor complex (proof lines 4596-4598).
Deduce exactness of G_1 tensor_{O_U} F|_U -> G_2 tensor_{O_U} F|_U -> G_3 tensor_{O_U} F|_U, i.e. flatness of F|_U, completing the proof up to line 4603 (proof lines 4599-4603).
proof_roadmap: Transport the exact complex to the site via extension by zero.
Use flatness of the original module there.
Return to U using compatibility with tensor products.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that restricting a flat module along an object U of a ringed site preserves flatness. The proof takes an exact complex of modules on U, uses exactness of extension by zero together with flatness of the original module to conclude that the complex obtained by extending by zero after tensoring is exact, then applies the compatibility of extension by zero with tensor products and the fact that extension by zero is faithful to deduce exactness after tensoring over U, which is precisely flatness of the restriction (proof lines 4587-4603). H2: the transport of exactness through extension by zero and the use of its compatibility with tensor products is the substance.
